sloka: प्रविष्टा हरि शार्दूला बिलम् तिमिर आवृतम् ।न तेषाम् सज्जते दृष्टिः न तेजः न पराक्रमः ॥४-५०-१९॥
transliteration: praviṣṭā hari śārdūlā bilam timira āvṛtam ।na teṣām sajjate dṛṣṭiḥ na tejaḥ na parākramaḥ ॥4-50-19॥

translations.english: The monkeys could not fix their eyes anywhere.Their lustre or valour could not help them. They moved like wind uninterrupted and their vision was lost in darkness.
translations.hindi: उसने ही यह सब सुवणंमय बन अपवी माया के बल से बनाया हे । पहले यह दानव, मुख्यदानवो का Se शिल्पी था
